kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننكسر (form VII)
# نَنْكَسِرُ (nankasiru) /nan.ka.si.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْكَسَرَ (inkasara)
# نَنْكَسِرَ (nankasira) /nan.ka.si.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْكَسَرَ (inkasara)
# نَنْكَسِرْ (nankasir) /nan.ka.sir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْكَسَرَ (inkasara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
